description: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester School Registration and Fee System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /bilal/normal/pay_report.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument period results in sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.
